zh.connectionInstructions: 给 Agent 的连接说明
zh.unavailable: 接口尚未就绪。请确认组件已开启，稍后刷新；仍失败时请重新开启组件。
zh.portBusy: 保存的端口被其他程序占用。连接信息已保留，请释放端口后重新开启组件。
zh.localHint: 由当前运行插件的电脑提供接口。换一台电脑安装后，会生成那台电脑自己的连接信息，支持能发送 HTTP 请求的本机 Agent。
zh.retained: 关闭组件会立即停止连接，地址和密钥保留；再次开启后可继续使用原连接。密钥用于管理 DSH，请只交给你授权的 Agent。
zh.manualCopy: 无法自动复制，已选中连接说明，请手动复制。
zh.desktopReady: 设置、插件管理和桌面退出/重启适配已就绪。
zh.desktopWaiting: 设置和插件管理已可用。首次桌面适配将在正常退出 DSH 后安装，下次打开后可使用正常退出/重启接口；不用现在退出。
zh.desktopUnsupported: 设置和插件管理可用；当前系统或 DSH 版本暂不支持正常退出/重启接口。
zh.desktopError: 设置和插件管理可用；桌面适配未完成。请重新开启组件后查看状态。
zh.hiddenKey: 〈复制连接说明时会包含密钥〉

en.unavailable: The interface is not ready. Check that the component is enabled and refresh; if it persists, disable and enable it again.
en.portBusy: Another program is using the saved port. Your connection details are retained; free the port and enable the component again.
en.localHint: The API runs on whichever computer has this plugin installed. Each computer creates its own connection details for local Agents that can make HTTP requests.
en.retained: Disabling immediately stops connections and retains the address and key. Re-enabling restores the same connection. The key can manage DSH; share it only with an Agent you authorize.
en.manualCopy: Automatic copying failed. The instructions are selected; copy them manually.
en.desktopReady: Settings, plugin management and the graceful quit/restart adapter are ready.
en.desktopWaiting: Settings and plugin management are available. First-time desktop setup runs after DSH exits normally; graceful quit/restart becomes available on the next launch. You do not need to exit now.
en.desktopUnsupported: Settings and plugin management are available. Graceful quit/restart is not supported on this OS or DSH version yet.
en.desktopError: Settings and plugin management are available; desktop setup is incomplete. Disable and enable this component to inspect its status again.
en.hiddenKey: <included when you copy the connection instructions>
